description: This file defines the WorkspaceController class with methods for managing workspaces, including create, read, update, delete, switch workspace, and sharing functionalities, utilizing various services and handling HTTP requests/responses.

classes.name: WorkspaceController
classes.description: Controller class handling workspace-related HTTP requests such as create, read, update, delete, switch, and sharing functionalities.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new workspace using WorkspaceUserService and returns the created workspace.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads workspace(s) by ID or organization ID, handling database query and response.

methods.name: switchWorkspace
methods.description: Switches the current workspace for the user, updating session and user context.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a workspace by ID, handling transaction management.

methods.name: getSharedWorkspacesForItem
methods.description: Retrieves shared workspaces associated with a specific item ID.

methods.name: setSharedWorkspacesForItem
methods.description: Sets shared workspaces for a specific item ID based on request body.
